title: License details: updates ended
summary: The same DJDL page for Kenji, whose yearly Studio license stopped renewing on Sep 30, 2026 and keeps the last version (licenses.list's 'Updates ended … keeps working' row). The state is said once, as the warning pill 'Updates ended' beside the name; the page's one solid action downloads 4.1.3, the last covered version; Get it's neutral callout says why its files are 4.1.3; the License card's term block says when and how it ended and holds the one Renew. Nothing else on the page warns: devices on 4.1.3 are fine, and the entitlements stay. The phone render emails the 4.1.3 download.
compare: Header: 'DJDL' with the warning pill 'Updates ended' (alert glyph) beside it, 'by Example Audio' under it, and 'Download 4.1.3' as the page's only solid button, never a build the license doesn't cover (PORTAL.md §5.4, 'Expired, an older build is covered'). A keeps-the-last-version lapse is a warning, not 'Expired · danger' (that stays for stop licenses; PORTAL.md §5.3 needs the row).

One state, said once (owner, 2026-10-08; UI-KITS §1.5 rule 9): the header pill is the status. Get it's callout is neutral (info glyph, no tone), because it explains rather than warns: '4.2.0 isn't in your license' over 'Your license covers versions in 4.1.x, the latest of which is 4.1.3.' (the owner's wording: the version line, not the cover date). The License card's term block says when and how it ended and holds the one Renew. No 'Not included' row for 4.2.0, no 'not in your license' on What's new, no 'your version' mark on 4.1.3, no warning on a device.

Get it: the head 'Get it' with '4.1.3 · Sep 22, 2026' on the right, the callout, then one downloads table of 4.1.3's files (Platform, SHA-256, Download): the Mac build is the tinted first row, 'macOS · Universal' over 'For your Mac · .dmg · 82 MB', with an outlined Download, then Windows x64; each with a middle-truncated SHA-256 and a labelled Copy; the foot holds SHA256SUMS.

Term block: 'Updates ended at 4.1.3' (LX-15's line) over 'Keeps working' and 'Renewal stopped Sep 30, 2026', one per line; the chart full from Sep 30, 2025 to Sep 30, 2026, then the dashed accent stretch (on: today is past the end) labelled 4.1.3, with 'Today, Oct 7' over its marker in that stretch; the track visible in both themes.

Under the chart, 'Renew with Example Audio' as an outlined button with the external-link glyph (the developer's renew link, on their site): the page's one Renew, in the card the route lands on. No paragraph restating the title and the callout.

A stop license (no keeps-the-last-version) never gets this copy: its pill is 'Expired' (danger), the term reads 'Ended Sep 30, 2026', Get it lists no build it no longer covers, and the action is 'Renew with Example Audio to keep using it' (not drawn).

Facts: License source 'From Example Audio' (issued by hand), Works offline for '30 days', Release track 'Stable', License key 'None' over 'A new device signs in instead'; then the full-width Included 'Stem separation · 4 decks · Recording · Cloud Sync' (keeps-the-last-version keeps entitlements; only newer versions stop). No Activated fact: the chart starts at the last renewal. No add-ons table: Studio holds none.
What's new keeps 4.2.0's notes with no subtitle and no 'not in your license' (the callout said it); Earlier versions is a compact table (4.1.3 Sep 22, 2026; 4.1.2 Sep 9, 2026).

Devices: '2 of 10 in use' with a neutral bar in the head (ten devices draw as a bar, not ten segments); two devices on 4.1.3 with no warning: Kenji's MacBook Pro ('macOS · 4.1.3' over 'This device') and Booth PC ('Windows · 4.1.3' over 'Last seen Oct 2'), each with Remove. Remove and Delete synced data confirm as on portal.license.

Cloud Sync and DJDL knows you as as on portal.license, with Kenji's data: '212 MB of 1 GB used'; Crates 3,410 168 MB, Cue points 40,200 tracks 44 MB, Settings 11 4 KB; 'Kenji Sato' over 'kenji@example.com · passkey'.

Phone renders stand for a phone user agent (PORTAL.md §5.4): the pill stays beside the name, then 'Email me the download' (solid, full width) and the ⋯, with 'We'll email the link to 4.1.3 to kenji@example.com.' under them (no orphan last word); no tinted row, no 'For your Mac', no SHA-256 column, icon Download buttons, no 'This device'.

Sizes as portal.license: three columns from 1280 px, one column under 1100 px under the jump bar in its order (Get it, License, Devices, Cloud Sync, DJDL knows you as, What's new, Help). Phone: the jump bar scrolls sideways with a faded edge, License marked; Cloud Sync's buttons stack full width; the footer sits above the bottom bar, whose Activate is the outlined pill.
Checks: no sideways scroll from 320 to 2560 px; axe (WCAG 2.2 AA) 0 violations at 390, 1024, 1440 and 1920 in both themes; one visible h1; the screen writes no margin, padding or gap.

Portal v2 (B2, B12): the docked header, the one filled primary is ink, tile actions outlined, the page h1 at the display step (48/52, 32/36 on a phone) with no full stop or eyebrow, no glow or wash, no chartreuse; text never painted over art; weights 400/500/600.
The owner's 2026-10-08 decision stands (B12): the state is said once (the 'Updates ended' pill), no 'Not included' row, Renew only in the License card.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Needs fixes, now applied: one solid button, the downloadable 4.1.3 builds grouped first with 4.2.0 as one quiet row, the phone emails the download, and the lapse is said once at the top and once in full.

findings.issue: Three solid violet buttons (header Download 4.1.3, recommended Download, Renew) with no clear main action.
findings.resolution: Header 'Download 4.1.3' is the only solid button; the recommended Download is outlined; Renew with Example Audio is an outlined button with the external-link glyph, and is also the link in the '4.2.0 isn't in your license' callout.

findings.issue: All platforms mixed 4.2.0 Not included rows with 4.1.3 downloads; bold 'Not included' was the strongest text; rows you can't download kept a SHA-256 and copy.
findings.resolution: Grouped: 'Your version, 4.1.3' with its macOS and Windows rows, then one quiet row '4.2.0 for macOS and Windows · Released after your updates ended · Not included' in muted regular weight (the kit draws Rubik at 400 and 700 only, so no medium weight), with no SHA-256, copy or download. The row has no second Renew: the callout at the top of the same card carries it (density finding).

findings.issue: Phone header was the pill plus a solid 'Download 4.1.3'; PORTAL.md §5.4 gives 'Email me the download'.
findings.resolution: Phone: the pill on its own line, then 'Email me the download' (solid, full width, §5.4's words; the email names 4.1.3) and the overflow; the recommended card becomes the callout 'We'll email kenji@example.com a link to 4.1.3 that opens on your Mac or PC.'; no 'this device'.

findings.issue: The '4.2.0 isn't in your license' callout had no action; the only Renew was about 1,400 px further down on phone.
findings.resolution: 'Renew with Example Audio ↗' is the callout's link, under its text rather than in the trailing slot, which would squeeze the text into a narrow column on phone.

findings.issue: The lapse was said about nine times, reading as alarm.
findings.resolution: Said once at the top (pill, callout with Renew) and once in full (duration block). Dropped the 'Covers versions' fact (Release track takes its place), the holder box's 'and install 4.1.3' and the two 'Released after your updates ended' rows (one quiet row now); 'yours to keep' became 'your version'; What's new keeps 'not in your license'.

findings.issue: The bar's left end read 'Sep 30, 2025' while Activated said Sep 30, 2024.
Versus house doc: the warning 'Updates ended' pill is better than PORTAL.md §5.3's 'Expired · danger'.
findings.resolution: No mockup change. The PORTAL.md §5.3 update (an 'Updates ended · warning' row for keeps-the-last-version licenses, quick action Download <last covered version>; 'Expired · danger' only for stop licenses) is noted for the lead: PORTAL.md is outside the mockups directory.
